diagrams.title: **Orchestration and persistence, separated
diagrams.caption: **Orchestration and persistence, separated.** LangGraph runs the reasoning and tools; `AgentCoreMemorySaver` bridges to AgentCore Memory, where state and checkpoints are stored durably. That split is what makes the agent multi-session and production-grade.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 700" aria-label="Math agent architecture. The user asks: what is 1337 times 515321, then add 412. Inside the LangGraph runtime, an agent built with create_agent handles LLM reasoning, math tools and state. It calls the LLM, Claude Haiku 4.5 via Bedrock, and the math tools add and multiply. The LangGraph component AgentCoreMemorySaver saves and loads state, mapping thread_id to session_id and actor_id to actor_id. It stores everything in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory, the persistent state storage holding conversation history, checkpoints and state, and multiple sessions, in the resource MathLanggraphAgent." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-brain" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-brain" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-tool" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-tool" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-proto" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-proto" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-data" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-data" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>

diagrams.title: **The graph `create_agent` builds
diagrams.caption: **The graph `create_agent` builds.** A request enters at `__start__`, the model node either finishes or routes to the tools node, and tool results flow back to the model. Dashed edges are conditional. The checkpointer saves the state behind the scenes.
diagrams.svg:
